newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain unemployment fell to 21.37 pct in Feb-April.
newsitem.headline: Spain unemployment fell to 21.37 pct in Feb-April.

text.p: Spanish unemployment from February to April 1997 fell 0.12 points to 21.37 percent, the National Statistics Institute (INE) said on Friday.
The data is based on the INE survey completed on a quarterly rolling basis.
INE said the number of jobless fell 0.28 percent from the previous month to 3.43 million.
The unemployment rate stands at 28.55 percent for women and at 16.81 percent for men.
The total number of employed rose 0.45 percent to 12.63 million.
